Sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-4|infrastructure]] is the only permanent alternative. It operates at the base layer. It uses tools no single company can restrict. It gives you ownership of your stack, your data, and your revenue stream. This is not a replacement for Stripe. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe and its clones offer rented infrastructure. You build on their platform. They control the terms. They can change fees, freeze accounts, or withdraw from your country without warning. Their compliance teams decide if you operate. Their payment networks decide if your customers can pay. Alternatives like NOWPayments offer payment verification without custody. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare—infrastructure no company can shut down. Your backend logic lives in Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Your orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-6|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] in 48 hours. You own it after deployment. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. No single point of failure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal use IP geolocation, billing address checks, and currency blacklists to enforce restrictions. Their compliance algorithms flag Nigerian transactions as high-risk—even when the buyer’s funds are legitimate. Their country-level blocks are not negotiable. Their support teams cannot override them. Workarounds fail because the platforms actively detect and close proxy accounts. Sovereign infrastructure avoids this entirely. It uses on-chain payment verification. It does not rely on IP-based billing or currency conversion. Buyers send crypto directly to your wallet. The system verifies the transaction on-chain. The product delivers automatically. No middleman can block the payment. No algorithm can flag the buyer’s location. The architecture is permissionless by design.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. PayPal charges 3.49% + $0.49. Both add currency conversion fees when they operate in your country. Crypto payments through NOWPayments charge 0.5%. No conversion fees. No buyer account required. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Payment confirms on-chain in minutes. The webhook fires instantly. The product delivers automatically. Stripe and PayPal hold funds for days—sometimes weeks. They can freeze your account without explanation. Sovereign infrastructure gives you direct access to your revenue. No intermediary holds your funds. No platform can freeze your account. The cost is upfront. The ownership is permanent.
Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround—it is base-layer architecture.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal own your payment data. They control your revenue stream. Their platforms dictate how you operate. Their algorithms decide if your transactions are valid. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store runs on infrastructure you control. Your payment verification is on-chain. Your product delivery is automatic. The Edge Commerce Stack configures this for you. It loads your products. It sets up your payment webhook. It tests your delivery system. It hands you the keys. COREMERCH has no access after deployment. No platform can shut you down. No algorithm can freeze your revenue. The system is yours to operate, scale, and modify.

If you sell digital products to a global audience and cannot use Stripe or PayPal, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only structural solution. It is not a workaround. It is base-layer architecture. It uses tools no company can restrict. It gives you ownership of your stack, your data, and your revenue stream. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture in 48 hours. It is not a temporary fix. It is a permanent alternative. It is built for creators who choose to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. If you are tired of platform rejection, this is your architecture.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can Stripe or PayPal unblock Nigeria?

No. Their country-level blocks are compliance features, not bugs. Their algorithms flag Nigerian transactions as high-risk. Their support teams cannot override this. Sovereign infrastructure avoids this by using on-chain payment verification and permissionless hosting.
What if my buyers don’t use crypto?

Educate them. Provide clear instructions on how to purchase crypto on BSC, Solana, or TRON for under $0.10 in fees. These networks are fast, cheap, and widely available. Your buyers will adapt when they see the value of your products.
Can COREMERCH shut down my store?
No. After deployment, you own the entire stack. COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure, your data, or your revenue stream. Your store runs on open tools no company can restrict.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms on-chain, the buyer cannot reverse it. This eliminates chargeback risk entirely. Your revenue is secure the moment the webhook fires.
What if I need to scale my store?
